Headteacher's Welcome
I am delighted to welcome you to Kings International College, where our vision is to ignite and fulfil aspirations.
We provide an exceptional education that not only imparts knowledge but instils a lifelong love for learning and personal growth. Students are encouraged to explore their interests, discover their passions and develop their talents. By nurturing a culture of opportunity, we broaden our students' horizons and expand their possibilities.
Community cohesion is at the heart of our activities and essential in supporting our students' aspirations.
We foster a strong sense of belonging, inclusivity and collaboration, with the aim of creating a thriving environment supported by peers, teachers and the wider community.
Underpinning our approach are our values of aspiration, resilience and respect. A relentless focus on embedding these values across the school enables our students to be happy and ultimately fulfil their aspirations. We welcome visitors. Please do come and experience it for yourselves.

Careers Advice and Guidance
Welcome to the Careers Section of our website. Please see the tabs below relating to different aspects of careers.
If you are an employer, business or ex-student of Kings please click here to see how you can help! Kings International College Careers Team Level 6 Qualified Careers Advisor – Mrs L Bowman Careers Link Governor Careers – Mrs J Phillips Line Manager for Careers – Mrs J Wilson Careers and Enterprise Surrey Careers Hub Coordinator – Miss R Roberts Teachers, Parents, Governors and Students can access the policy here:
Careers Access Policy and CEIAG Strategy
It contains a summary of the careers programme, including details of how to access information about the careers programme, how the school measures and assesses the impact of the careers programme on pupils and the date of the school’s next review of the information published.
Kings run multiple careers related events over the course of a year, our recent trip to Pinewood Studios Futures Festival is featured here. Kings International School are proudly working in partnership with the National Careers Service. If you would like to speak to an advisor in relation to careers advice, please click the National Careers Service button below: https://nationalcareers.service.gov.uk
Visit the Policies section of the website to view our Careers Policies
Applications and Personal Statements
Make sure that you are prepared for all the standard pieces of information that you will need to complete an application:
The personal statement is your chance to showcase yourself. It is an opportunity to stand out from the crowd before meeting someone in person. Use your word count wisely and make sure you sell yourself. Below are some pointers and tips to help you make the most of it:
You may be eligible for the 16-19 bursary fund. This fund assists with financial pressures associated with education. There are eligibility criteria that must be met to apply, and it is intended for expenses such as transport and school equipment. For more information, visit the relevant website.
Date of Birth
Contact number
Parent / Carer contact details
Have a standard personal statement ready
Supporting information
Apprenticeships
If you are interested in applying for an apprenticeship, please visit the Find an Apprenticeship page by clicking here.
There are lots of other opportunities below, and if you are interested in any of these you should apply directly. If you need any assistance with this, please contact Mrs L Bowman, Careers Coordinator, at bowmanli@kingsint.uk
Here at BT, we’ve got a whole host of roles in customer service, supporting our business customers.
But that’s not all. We’ve also got roles available as a Field Support Technician, Security Power Engineer, Sales Specialist, and in Cyber Security – among others. Whatever it is you fancy, we’re sure we’ll have something that catches your eye. Click the image to find out more!
British Airways has recently recorded a series of webinars in partnership with the National Career Service. They are approximately 30 minutes long. You can watch them back using these links:
BA Engineering Apprentices Vlog
Students can join their student website, Speedbird-Z (free), to chat with colleagues from across the business first-hand (including current apprentices) and complete online learning modules about aviation and employability: Speedbird-Z.
Would someone else be interested in these opportunities? Click here to forward this to students, colleagues, or friends.
If you have any questions or need any help, please get in touch with us at team@successatschool.org.
bowmanli@kingsint.uk

Independent Careers Guidance Adviser
All students in Year 10 will receive a 40-minute one-to-one Careers and Guidance Interview with Mrs L Bowman, Careers Coordinator, to support their transition into post-16 education.
Career Pilot
Career Pilot is a free resource for you and your child to obtain information and advice in relation to careers.
The website is very easy to use and has a whole host of information ranging from career choices, subject choices, providers, college and university courses to apprenticeships and other courses. It is recommended that you encourage your child to use this website as often as possible to prepare them for the world of work and their future. There is also lots of useful information for parents.
bowmanli@kingsint.uk
CEIAG
CEIAG Strategy and Access Policy
01276 683539bowmanli@kingsint.uk
Visit the Policies section of the website to view our Careers Policies
Employers, Businesses and Alumni
Our young people are entering an increasingly uncertain and quickly evolving job market at a time of great financial and political change. Our aim is to help every student reach their full potential and progress to a successful destination by providing them with the widest possible range of employer and career-related opportunities.
We appreciate the help and support of businesses to ensure that every child leaves us with high aspirations and is equipped for a happy and successful future.
If you are an employer, business, or ex-student of Kings and would like to help, please get in touch! If you are an ex-student of Kings and would like to be part of our Alumni group, sharing your career journey, we would love to hear from you.
Mrs L Bowman Careers Coordinator bowmanli@kingsint.uk01276 683539Or complete the Contact Us form.
We know how precious your time is and value any contribution, however small. To assist, we have provided a breakdown of the ways you can support us. The list is not exhaustive — we are always looking for new ideas and suggestions.
Site visits: Host a small group of students
Interview preparation: Share tips and help with mock interviews
Work Experience: Provide a placement for one or more students
1 week (usually at the beginning of April)
Careers Fair: Participate during Parents Evenings
Early Evening (4 PM onwards)
Guest lectures/talks: Share your expertise with students
1 hour (or during assembly, 20 minutes)
Projects: Set a challenge for students and judge the results
Sponsorship: Sponsor an event financially or in-kind
Employability skills: Share your networking and business skills
Flexible — e.g., a 15-minute assembly, class discussion, or a 1-hour session on specific skills

Speakers for Schools
All these speakers have amazing and interesting stories to share, offering valuable advice to students. By continuing to provide these videos, we engage professionals in the working world who may not have the time or confidence to speak in a school setting.
Click here to visit our channel. On this channel, you will also find an Interview Skills Presentation created by a local company, Aetna International.
This is a fantastic resource that gives students real insights into what to expect from an employer, how to prepare, and how to deal with setbacks.
The Careers Access Provider is Mrs L Bowman, Careers Coordinator.
bowmanli@kingsint.uk
Unifrog
Unifrog is an online platform that supports schools and colleges to deliver their statutory duty to provide students with impartial and independent guidance on a full range of Post-16 and Post-18 options.
Unifrog is the only place where students can compare every undergraduate course in the UK as well as international opportunities. Additionally, Unifrog provides students with access to the most comprehensive list of live apprenticeships available across the country, including Higher and degree apprenticeships, as well as further education courses.
Once students have explored their interests and compared the full range of pathways available to them, Unifrog provides one place for students to draft all materials needed for applications such as CVs and Personal Statements.
All students, across all year groups, now have access to the platform in keeping with our commitment to provide students with outstanding careers guidance and tailored support when choosing their next step.
Unifrog is a whole-school careers platform. It allows teachers and careers advisors to track their pupils’ progress and keep a record of their research and all of the careers interactions each student has received. It makes it easy for teachers and careers advisors to work with students to find the best next step for them. Staff are able to provide feedback on applications, comment on students’ research, log careers interviews and interactions, upload action plans, and provide support and feedback on application materials.
Every parent/carer can have their own login to Unifrog, where they can access the tools, information, and guidance to support their child to make their best next step.
If you would like more information on Unifrog, please visit their website at www.unifrog.org, or speak to our Careers Coordinator, Mrs Lisa Bowman.

Please click here for the BET Governance & Scheme of Delegation page.
Keith Dixon – Chair - Co-Opted Governor
I am married to Angela and father to two girls, Lucy and Abby. I work full time as a Mechanical Design Manager in Electric/Hybrid vehicle development.
I have been a governor at a local primary school in Ash for over 12 years. I hope this experience will assist me in making a positive contribution to governance at Kings. I made a promise to support the school after my youngest daughter finished her short, but very enjoyable time at Kings.
Jenny Tuck - Co-Opted Governor
I have worked in education for my entire career with a SEN focus.
David Harrison – Co-Opted Governor
I moved to Camberley in 2010 and live within walking-distance of Kings. My two children both benefited from their Kings experience, completing their GCSEs in 2022 and 2025. I have supported the school as a governor since 2020, with particular responsibilities for finance and health & safety, and have been impressed by the school’s tremendous progress. I’m a strong supporter of the school’s values of high aspirations, resilience and respect, and look forward to helping shape its continued success.
Owen Gardner - Parent Governor
I have two children at Kings.
Paul Jackson – Co-Opted Governor
I enjoy all forms of sport and have played rugby to a good level. Unfortunately, age and injury has enforced retirement from playing. I now coach my son’s rugby team and passionately watch and follow Harlequins and England rugby teams. Retirement has also meant I have taken up cycling, yes I'm a MAMIL!
Motorsport has always interested me and I have been lucky enough to attend the Le Mans 24Hr race; a must for all motorsport enthusiasts. My family and I enjoy camping holidays as often as we can, I was heavily involved with the scouting movement as a young person and the enjoyment of being outdoors has never left. I would like to bring my experience of working in many different schools and Alternative Provision to Kings International in order to better the lives of the students at the school.
Vivienne Morell - Staff Governor
I am Head of Maths at Kings and provide a staff insight into discussions within the governing body and believe wholeheartedly in the vision at Kings.
June Phillips – Co-Opted Governor
I am married with two children and four grandchildren and have lived and worked in the Frimley/Camberley area since 1978. I retired from teaching in 2016, having taught Science (main subject Physics) for 28 years. During that time I held a variety of responsibility posts both pastoral and academic. I have a particular interest in teaching and learning and currently act as link governor to Careers and EDI. As a governor I support the aspirations of the school and value the opportunity to use my past experience to support Kings International to fulfil their aspirations for the whole school community, which are so evident when visiting the school

Sports Fixtures
Within PE we compete across both Hampshire and Surrey counties. The sports we participate in can be seen below. Outside of competing externally we have Inter-house sporting battles happening throughout the year in various sports such as table tennis, football and the college classic ‘Kingball’.
In the PE department and as a school we are constantly aspiring to increase our success and engagement across a range of sports. All students are welcome to attend our clubs regardless of experience, whether that is to compete or just for recreation.

pageCache.text:
Announcements
Congratulations on your GCSE's!
Congratulations to the Class of 2026!
Everyone at Kings is so proud of your achievements. They reflect the aspiration, resilience and dedication that you have shown during your time at Kings.
We thank our pastoral and curriculum teams who have supported the students. Their commitment, every day, has been focused on helping our students fulfil their aspirations. Importantly, these results provide our students with the opportunities to move onto the next stage of their lives.
We wish all our 2026 leavers the very best in the next stage of their lives.
